column1: # Legal forms ISO 20275 does not list for a served country that has other ISO forms (curated
# 2026-11-10): mostly sole traders, who register with the tax office or a municipality rather
# than a company registry, and general partnerships of the common-law countries. They carry no
# ISO code. Countries with no ISO forms at all are in form_templates.tsv.
# share: the form's share of its group where known (the UK's 0.36M ordinary partnerships beside
# 0.11M registered LPs and LLPs; Brazil's 12.6M MEI beside about 1M other sole traders); empty
# rows share what is left equally with the ISO forms.
